intro: This page collects research software and computational projects arising from my physics research. For the underlying physics, see [Research](research.html). For broader data science, machine learning and engineering projects, see [Scientific Computing](data-engineering.html).

research_projects.title: KEWPIE3
paragraphs: **Objective:** validate and publish KEWPIE3, the refinement of the KEWPIE2 cascade code with an implemented and calibrated formation step, for fusion-evaporation cross-section predictions in superheavy element synthesis.
**Key question:** how can the calculation of the compound nucleus formation probability be improved with Langevin-based stochastic approaches?
**Focus:** compound-nucleus formation · stochastic reaction dynamics · model calibration · uncertainty and sensitivity analysis
[Full KEWPIE3 project page, with calibration, results and predictions →](kewpie3.html)
research_projects.topics: Nuclear reaction modelling · Bayesian calibration · Scientific computing

research_projects.title: Fusion Dynamics and Fusion-by-Diffusion
paragraphs: Reassessment of the fusion dynamics underlying the fusion-by-diffusion description of fusion–evaporation reactions.

research_projects.title: Uncertainty in Nuclear Reaction Models
paragraphs: Investigation of parameter variation, calibration and uncertainty propagation in nuclear reaction models.
